1: package llmverify
2: 
3: import chisel3._
4: import chisel3.util._
5: import chiselFv._
6: 
7: // GCD circuit for unsigned N-bit numbers
8: class Gcd(val N: Int = 8, val logN: Int = 3) extends Module with Formal {
9:   val io = IO(new Bundle {
10:     val start = Input(Bool())
11:     val a = Input(UInt(N.W))
12:     val b = Input(UInt(N.W))
13:     val busy = Output(Bool())
14:     val o = Output(UInt(N.W))
15:   })
16:   
17:   // Internal registers
18:   val lsb = RegInit(0.U(logN.W))
19:   val x = RegInit(0.U(N.W))
20:   val y = RegInit(0.U(N.W))
21:   val busyReg = RegInit(false.B)
22:   val oReg = RegInit(0.U(N.W))
23:   
24:   // Helper function to select bit based on lsb using dynamic bit selection
25:   def select(z: UInt, lsb: UInt): UInt = {
26:     // Use dynamic bit selection - this is equivalent to the Verilog function
27:     z(lsb)
28:   }
29:   
30:   // Wires
31:   val xy_lsb = Wire(UInt(2.W))
32:   val diff = Wire(UInt(N.W))
33:   val done = Wire(Bool())
34:   val load = Wire(Bool())
35:   
36:   xy_lsb := Cat(select(x, lsb), select(y, lsb))
37:   diff := Mux(x < y, y - x, x - y)
38:   done := ((x === y) || (x === 0.U) || (y === 0.U)) && busyReg
39:   load := io.start && !busyReg
40:   
41:   // Data path logic
42:   when(load) {
43:     x := io.a
44:     y := io.b
45:     lsb := 0.U
46:   }.elsewhen(busyReg && !done) {
47:     switch(xy_lsb) {
48:       is(0.U) { // 2'b00
49:         lsb := lsb + 1.U
50:       }
51:       is(1.U) { // 2'b01
52:         x := Cat(0.U(1.W), x(N-1, 1))
53:       }
54:       is(2.U) { // 2'b10
55:         y := Cat(0.U(1.W), y(N-1, 1))
56:       }
57:       is(3.U) { // 2'b11
58:         when(x < y) {
59:           y := Cat(0.U(1.W), diff(N-1, 1))
60:         }.otherwise {
61:           x := Cat(0.U(1.W), diff(N-1, 1))
62:         }
63:       }
64:     }
65:   }.elsewhen(done) {
66:     oReg := Mux(x < y, x, y)
67:   }
68:   
69:   // Controller logic
70:   when(!busyReg) {
71:     when(io.start) {
72:       busyReg := true.B
73:     }
74:   }.otherwise {
75:     when(done) {
76:       busyReg := false.B
77:     }
78:   }
79:   
80:   // Connect outputs
81:   io.busy := busyReg
82:   io.o := oReg
83: 
84:   // ========== Formal Verification Assertions ==========
85: 
86:   // Safety: When load fires (io.start asserted while not busy),
87:   //         busyReg must be true in the next cycle
88:   assertNextStepWhen(load, busyReg, "load_causes_busy")
89: 
90:   // Safety: When done fires (x==y or x==0 or y==0 while busy),
91:   //         busyReg must be false in the next cycle
92:   assertNextStepWhen(done, !busyReg, "done_clears_busy")
93: 
94:   // Bounded Liveness: When a computation is started (load fires),
95:   //                   the result must be ready (done fires) within
96:   //                   128 cycles. For 8-bit inputs, the binary GCD
97:   //                   algorithm completes well within this bound.
98:   astRelaxedLiveness(load, done, 128, "gcd_terminates_within_128_cycles")
99: }
100: 
101: // Testbench for the gcd circuit
102: class TestGcd(val N: Int = 8, val logN: Int = 3) extends Module {
103:   val io = IO(new Bundle {
104:     val x = Input(UInt(N.W))
105:     val y = Input(UInt(N.W))
106:     val s = Input(Bool())
107:     val busy = Output(Bool())
108:     val o = Output(UInt(N.W))
109:   })
110:   
111:   // Internal registers
112:   val a = RegInit(0.U(N.W))
113:   val b = RegInit(0.U(N.W))
114:   val start = RegInit(false.B)
115:   
116:   // Unit under test
117:   val gcdModule = Module(new Gcd(N, logN))
118:   gcdModule.io.start := start
119:   gcdModule.io.a := a
120:   gcdModule.io.b := b
121:   
122:   // Update registers on clock edge
123:   a := io.x
124:   b := io.y
125:   start := io.s
126:   
127:   // Connect outputs
128:   io.busy := gcdModule.io.busy
129:   io.o := gcdModule.io.o
130: }
131: 
132: object VerilogGenerator extends App {
133:   // Generate Verilog for GCD module
134:   emitVerilog(new Gcd(), Array("--target-dir", "generated"))
135:   
136:   // Generate Verilog for TestGcd module
137:   emitVerilog(new TestGcd(), Array("--target-dir", "generated"))
138: }
